TEST_SUBJECT_BOSS.name: Test Subject
rules: These 3 bodies are sequential phases, not simultaneous enemies: Adaptable revives Phase 1 as Phase 2, then Phase 2 as Phase 3.
Each transition removes all status effects; the body cannot be targeted until it revives.
timing: On-kill and Fatal effects trigger on each phase transition.
